summary: Iteration 129 — Tested 4-feature batch (Manual Nudge Fire, Recap Recipient Preview, Monthly Assurance Digest, Tour Polish/Spotlight) plus Control Intelligence regression. All backend endpoints (POST /engagement-nudges, GET /brief/recipients, GET/POST /assurance-digest/preview|send, PUT/GET /settings) verified via curl with admin session cookie. Frontend Playwright walk-through against public URL confirmed all data-testid hooks present and interactive: 6 CI tabs render, ci-fire-engagement-nudges toast fires ('no declining-readiness streak'), ci-recap-recipients-toggle reveals ci-recap-recipient-list with admin chip ci-recap-recipient-jblan2026@gmail.com, ci-digest-panel present with enabled-toggle/day/send controls, Send now shows 'assurance digest emailed' toast (sent:1), save + reload persisted digest_enabled=true/digest_day=15, ProspectTour spotlight rendered on steps 1-3, prospect-tour-clear cleared demo-mode-ribbon. Recap regression buttons (preview/history/send/save) all present. Environment cleaned: digest_enabled reset to false, digest_day=1; demo cleared.

issues: ci-digest-day number input is disabled when auto-send toggle is Off. This is reasonable UX, but means the UI cannot 'set a day while Off'. Not a bug — noted only because it required routing the digest_day reset through the API when the toggle was already Off during cleanup.

critical_code_review_comments: DefensibilityDashboard.jsx is large; digest+recap+auditor+timeline concerns could be split into subcomponents for maintainability.
ci-digest-day disable-when-Off is fine but ensure Save persists digest_day even when toggle is off (backend already does; UI OK).
seed_data_creation: ProspectTour seeded a demo journey; cleared via prospect-tour-clear. Digest send delivered 1 real email to admin (expected).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 features from Msg 168 batch are working end-to-end (backend + UI). Backend endpoints: /api/control-intelligence/engagement-nudges (POST -> {nudged:N}), /brief/recipients (recap_recipients union), /assurance-digest/preview & /send, and /settings now include digest_enabled + digest_day alongside existing recap/cadence keys. Frontend data-testids: ci-fire-engagement-nudges, ci-recap-recipients-toggle, ci-recap-recipient-list, ci-recap-recipient-<email>, ci-digest-panel, ci-digest-enabled-toggle, ci-digest-day, ci-digest-send, control-intel-start-walkthrough, prospect-tour, prospect-tour-spotlight, prospect-tour-next/back/clear/keep. Environment left clean (digest off, day=1, demo cleared).
